Signature item: a broad pirate saber hung with bells. She holds it at full scale: one whole object, drawn once, held in front of or beside her body; a long weapon keeps one straight, unbroken shaft with a single head or blade.
Exposure (bold): her robes open to show skin — the cross collar opened into a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare upper arms above detached wide sleeves (and bare shoulders where no shoulder guard sits), a high slit in the skirt panels showing the thigh; any armor pieces stay on and symmetrical. Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.

One figure only — no second character, horse or other creature. No readable text or numbers, except that a banner, seal or emblem may carry the single character 吳 or 甘. No logo, watermark, speech bubble or frame border. Three Kingdoms-era Chinese dress, architecture and materials only.
Avoid: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
